title: Implement encoded CRT address conversion for compact physical tensors
body:
The physical Gaussian tensor in #3935 leaves its CRT entrance and integer return open. This PR supplies the encoded coefficient-address conversion in both directions, using the unchanged full-support router once per conversion and streamed triangular CRT shifts. It carries every spectator record and pays the two padding/cropping scans required by the actual compact TensorPlan interface.

The complete conditional invoice includes routing, offset preparation, copies, restoration, fixed native compilation and retained backing. Under the explicitly inherited router and newer caller-family premises, it fits `O(V p^Φ log p)`, Φ=.99827619697. Multiplication requires three such conversions. Numerical tensor composition, prime supply and final integer normalization/recovery remain open; no new κ is claimed.

Validation covers every source column on four complete shapes in both directions, unequal-width descriptors checked against the unchanged codec, every padded prefix, nonzero invalid shear cells, 2,176 independent modular-inverse cases, the actual typed TensorPlan, and 20 malformed-input/algebra/ownership/source-integrity controls. The finite router fixtures use the literal q=2 branch, not production native execution.

Reproduce with Python 3.12:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/crt-address-streams
```

The registered replay downloads about 38.5 MB of exact pinned predecessor sources into temporary storage; an authenticated offline source-tree option and Git-free replay are documented. No predecessor archives are duplicated or modified. Author cold offline and read-only Git-free `-O` replays passed; a fresh local network run ended in a TLS handshake timeout before mathematics. Hosted registered replay subsequently passed on the exact published head: [run39233053124](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39233053124). It completed the fresh source download, full replay and unchanged-input check. Exact author receipts and the local transport limitation remain recorded in `VALIDATION.md`. Exact base: `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`; tensor/router source: #3935 at `240597ed313fc2854c0462b23c89dc3bae72aaf5`. Scope is a construction/interface contribution with a conditional cost argument, not a selected-frontier update.

Credit: Tekalign (`tekuuu`), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. CRT algebra follows Agarwal–Cooley and source08; the full router and tensor interface are Jose Manuel (`jmbarrancoml`)'s #3935, building on #3619 and its pinned predecessors. Existing source licenses, notices and attribution are retained; new work is Apache-2.0.

Jose Manuel's concurrent [interface clarification](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/3664#discussioncomment-19036660) confirms the layout convention and retains both final S factors. His prospective numerical recovery work remains separate from this pinned CRT-address contribution.
